notes: Both titles verified against the supplied references. Original source is the accepted manuscript; pagination differs from locator p. 12, but Table 5 and target slope row are identified. Printed b metric retained: the original Table 5 note states all b coefficients indicate standardized effects (SD = 1) on personality, despite requested unstandardized label. Replication source is the authors’ accepted manuscript matching the supplied title, with final journal DOI 10.1016/j.jrp.2019.06.009. Table 6 contains both unbalanced and balanced columns: the unbalanced replication analysis is selected (p. 20 explicitly identifies Buadj); balanced B for the same row is 0.05. Replication duration uses months, original uses years; no conversion performed. Replication p is null because no exact or explicit test-specific bound is printed for this unstarred coefficient; absence of an asterisk is not converted into a bound. Original p bound follows the star attached to the same coefficient. Both effects are change/slope effects, not intercept associations.
